description: PagerDuty MCP server for Cursor - manage incidents, services, schedules, on-call, and more directly from your IDE.

PAGERDUTY_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.title: PagerDuty OAuth Client ID
PAGERDUTY_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID of the OAuth app you registered in PagerDuty for Cursor. See https://docs.pagerduty.com/ai-automation/advance/pagerduty-mcp-server#step-1-choose-an-authorization-method

PAGERDUTY_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.title: PagerDuty OAuth Client Secret
PAGERDUTY_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of the same PagerDuty OAuth app. See https://docs.pagerduty.com/ai-automation/advance/pagerduty-mcp-server#step-1-choose-an-authorization-method
